title: The Sleeper Beyond

reference_images.role: edit target; refine only finger shape

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGET: the supplied Sleeper Beyond concept sheet. Keep the 3:2 page layout, mine cavern, two tiny cloaked figures, vertical dark-water barrier, little lantern, supporting inset positions and gritty painted style. Make ONE targeted correction across the main scene, upper-right inset and lower shape studies: REPLACE THE WORM-LIKE TALON with ONE ENORMOUS CURLED FINGER that initially resembles ANCIENT ARCHITECTURE.
The single pale structure must have three broad bent phalange-like lengths, blunt rounded knuckle ridges resembling worn architraves and stepped old masonry, and a SHORT BROAD FLATTENED DULL NAIL at the fingertip. No long pointed claw, fang, talon, serpentine segmentation or worm shape. Its joints should read as column-like spans until the nail and compressed skin-fold at one bend reveal the finger. Make the far mass partly obscure in the water so the viewer assembles the revelation rather than seeing a clean creature silhouette immediately. Retain dirty ivory stone-like SKIN with subtle bodily weight, not actual brickwork or a literal built arch. Only ONE finger; base disappears beyond view. No palm, extra digits, head, eye, entire hand/body, decorative symbols or explanation.
Keep main mining/human scale cues tiny. Keep lower-right condensation omen unchanged in subject. Preserve the same material palette and quiet terror; no glowing magic or extra monsters. Do not add text or HUD. This is a proposed environmental revelation, not a final-boss or relic design.
